    Restricting a Kronecker pair to its support #

    A Kronecker pair on a quiver D need not have every vertex in its support. Restricting it to the full subquiver on the support T gives a Kronecker pair (KroneckerPair.restrict) whose representations L(T) are the restrictions of the old ones; since these vanish off T, relations killing the old push-downs kill the new ones (Rep.pdAct_res_eq_zero). So covering data with a pair need no support condition (PairCoveringData.ofPair).
